risk_note: Taobao jump-to-app authorization, server sdk_token branch (D10-3704 / D10-3709 ①; plan TB-APP-AUTH C2 items 1-4, 6-8; no contract change, sdk_app_key is FU-TB-SDK-APP-KEY-SERVER after CT-TBAPP). The adapter uses a submitted SDK access token as the session for publisher.info.save (no token exchange), a duplicate filing reads back with publisher.info.get and is accepted only against the matching stored history; inviter code and inviter-account-equals-union-account checks, the filing attempt recorded first, and no token in logs / archives / errors all as before. The sdk_token app reference carries only the union app key and must be our own, else refused before any request; an sdk_token submission without an issued reference is refused before the attempt row and any request. Issuance allows sdk_token outside prod per union.taobao.auth_methods.<client>; prod still filters sdk_token (until CAP-TB-05 (f) passes and the owner confirms). Filing readiness is per method: only web_code needs the user OAuth redirect URI (an issued web_code state keeps the redirect recorded in it). TOP auth-class refusals (11/12/13/26/27/28/29 and session / app-key / permission isv.* sub codes, HTTP < 500 only) map to invalid_identity -> 30104 credential_invalid with exactly one flat TAOBAO_PUBLISHER_AUTH_REJECTED warning carrying code, sub_code and auth method only; HTTP >= 500 stays upstream_unavailable with the attempt left unknown. No migration, no money arithmetic. Recorded out of scope: FU-TB-SDK-APP-KEY-SERVER, FU-TB-AUTH-URL-STALE-COMMENT; staging config union.taobao.auth_methods.android is an ops step after deploy.
